Is Applied Optoelectronics' EML supply for 800G/1.6T constrained by InP substrate supply (given its four-inch wafer line) or by its own laser fab capacity?

Given IQE's customer-concentration risk (MACOM £45m strategic investment and long-term supply agreements), does a MACOM demand reduction directly hit IQE's epitaxy wafer utilization?

Given AXT's North America revenue concentration (only ~2% of 2025 revenue from North American customers vs ~8% in 2024) and tariff/export-control exposure on InP substrates, is AXT's revenue mix now China-weighted as InP demand tightens globally?
